messages:
alex: FYI canary promotion is blocked. deploy-bot failed to push the canary artifact to our registry, holding promotion.
deploy-bot: [AUTO] publish failed: registry.redwood.dev/rw-service:canary-20260320 -> 500 storage error: blob checksum mismatch (expected abc123, got def456). retry_count=2
mei: ugh. which step failed in the pipeline? push-artifacts or the registry server? any logs?
jamal: push-artifacts job exited nonzero earlier. pipeline shows: 
```
# ./ci/publish.sh --tag canary-20260320
Uploading layers...
Error: upload failed: POST /v2/rw-service/blobs/uploads/ -> 500
stderr: unexpected EOF
```
lena: can we just re-run the job? sometimes it's transient with the registry CDN
ricardo: re-run already tried by CI, same result. Looks like the blob was uploaded but checksum validation failed on our storage tier.
priya: if checksum mismatch then re-uploading same layers won't help. we should either rebuild artifact (new digest) or fall back to previous digest for the canary.
alex: we need a decision: block the production promotion or pin to previous digest for this release? change window in ~2h.
sre-bot: Incident created INC-3456 (canary artifact push failure). Pager rotated to on-call: jamal.
jamal: quick verification: previous canary digest rw-service@sha256:7788aabb is healthy in staging and passed smoke. I can promote that digest manually to the canary tag if we decide to un-block.
mei: manual promote + keep rolling for prod? i'm wary of moving forward without reproducing root cause. but if we pin to previous digest it's safer.
lena: agree with pin. we'll create a follow-up to rebuild the failing canary with stricter artifact checks, and keep the release notes that this commit was rolled to previous artifact digest temporarily.
ricardo: workaround steps I propose:
1) jamal run manual `registry copy` of sha256:7788aabb -> tags/canary-20260320 (preserve manifest)
2) promote canary -> run smoke e2e (5m)
3) if smoke ok, proceed with scheduled production rollout
priya: +1. also create a quick CI job to `docker pull sha256:... && docker inspect` to validate digest after push next time.
alex: ok let's do pin-and-promote. jamal, please run the manual promote and post the registry logs here. i'll update the release owner and change window.
jamal: doing it now.
deploy-bot: [AUTO] manual promote started by jamal. copying manifest sha256:7788aabb -> tags/canary-20260320
jamal: manifest copy succeeded. pulled canary image locally and ran smoke suite: all green (4 tests).
lena: thanks. alex, i'll draft a brief note for release notes: "Canary temporarily pinned to previous artifact digest due to artifact push checksum failure; follow-up rebuild in INC-3456." keep it short.
alex: updated release channel and notified PM. tagging this thread with #hold-until-rollback-resolved so we can re-evaluate after the rebuild.
ricardo: filing a PR to add post-push digest validation in CI: draft/ci-digest-check. will link to INC-3456.
priya: also add registry-side metric alert for checksum mismatch rate > 0.1%/hour.
jamal: closing this immediate block: canary promoted using previous digest. Rebuild ticket created. If any regressions show up, we rollback fully.
sre-bot: Closed temporary hold. INC-3456 assigned -> jamal. next update in 3h or on status change.
alex: thanks all. follow-ups: ricardo PR, priya alert, jamal rebuild. if anythinng flaps we abort production rollout."
